name: Mastermind
summary: Two-player code-breaking deduction game where one player sets a hidden color code and the other tries to crack it.
rules_text: Players agree on an even number of games and alternate roles. The Codemaker secretly places 4 code pegs in hidden holes, no color repeated in this version. The Decoder then makes up to 9 guesses, placing 4 colored pegs per row. After each guess the Codemaker gives feedback: number of pegs correct in both color and position (red), and number correct in color but wrong position (white). All previous guesses stay visible. If the Decoder guesses the code exactly, the game ends and Codemaker scores one point per guess row used. If not solved in 9 guesses, Codemaker scores 9. If Codemaker gives wrong feedback, replay and Decoder gets 3 bonus points. After the agreed games, highest total wins.
rating_reason: Classic hidden code deduction perfect for engine
reasons: capability: needs something the manifest has no word for: secret_code_evaluation_with_position_and_color_matching
